sec-bot: Pre-change hook: export CloudAudit logs and store checksum before granting roles (job scheduled at 1716804460).

Aisha Ramos: Actions: Tom - IAM inventory; Priya - audit proof + policy JSON; Nikita - KMS snapshot + scrubbed logs; Aisha - freeze scope + schedule 30m dry run with SRE.
Tom Li: Artifacts will land in tracker: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PT-2024 (placeholder).

```

gcloud logging sinks create pt-evidence gs://pt-evidence-bucket --log-filter="protoPayload.methodName:(Token OR Authenticate)"
```
